name: Final Passage
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You have done well, adventurer. You have passed my test, and the tests before mine. Return to Dorn in Thousand Needles. He will sense the change within you, and see that your mind, body and spirit are strong enough that you should be rewarded for your efforts.

Stay true to the balance you've shown throughout these trials, adventurer. Dorn will test you again in the future if you do.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, adventurer. It has been a long time since you have last stepped into my home. It seems like many moons have passed since you took your first leap that set you upon your path.

And now you return to me stronger than you once were... more enlightened. This pleases me. And you should be justly rewarded for seeing my tests to the end.

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 26 to 36, 17,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Test of Faith
quests.objectiveText: If you have faith, leap from the planks overlooking Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Endurance
quests.objectiveText: Bring Grenka's Claw to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Strength
quests.objectiveText: Bring Fragments of Rok'Alim to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find the Legacy of the Aspects and return it to Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat, and return it to Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again.

quests.name: Final Passage
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
